market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.9 (-13% over 5 days) despite the 10y near 5.0% after the Fed hike; chips rallied hard (SOXX +10% in 5 days) while crude fell on improving Middle East flows and US-Iran diplomacy hopes.

oil_gas.catalyst: none; headlines point to de-escalation: 'Oil prices settle lower as crude flows from Middle East improve' (Reuters), 'Oil Prices Fall on U.S.-Iran Diplomacy Hopes' (WSJ)
oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -4.5% on the day, -5.5% over 5 days; Saudi pipeline fix and diplomacy are the opposite of a new named supply loss. 'Iran vows it will not surrender' is rhetoric, not a supply event. Stay flat per the storyline rule.

gold_miners.catalyst: none; 'Chinese gold imports set record' (Yahoo Finance) is a demand data point but gold is -6% over 20 days with the 10y near 5% and the dollar firm
gold_miners.reasoning: Fed hike and high yields remain headwinds; analyst forecasts and record Chinese imports are not a fresh, unpriced catalyst for NEM. Flat.

chips.catalyst: no new NVDA catalyst today; the 2026-09-17 Huang 'twice as many chips next year' (CNBC) long is still held to about 10-01
chips.reasoning: NVDA +7.8% and SOXX +10% over 5 days: the Huang guidance is now largely priced. Today's headlines are AMD-centric ($1T club) and a networking challenger to Nvidia. No fresh call; let the existing hold run, exit on a guidance cut or export hit.

pharma.catalyst: 'Eli Lilly CEO says 700,000 new seniors have started GLP-1s after Medicare coverage, and 70% are on Lilly drugs' (CNBC, 2026-09-21): a concrete uptake disclosure implying upside to GLP-1 volume
pharma.reasoning: A company-specific demand datapoint after a -7% month; LLY only +2.3% over 5 days so not fully priced. Weaker than a trial or guidance raise, so confidence stays at the bar. No negative pricing headline today.

copper_uranium.catalyst: 'Copper Rises for a Sixth Day Toward Record on China Tightness' (Bloomberg, 2026-09-22): a named physical tightness in the main market, copper 1.7% from its 52-week high
copper_uranium.reasoning: Fresh squeeze headline in copper, the family's driver; FCX lagged copper over 20 days (-5.9% vs +1.6%). Copper already +5.6% in 5 days, so some is priced; confidence at the bar. Uranium headlines add supply (neutral for CCJ).

would_change_my_mind: A named new oil supply loss (re-enter XOM), an NVDA guidance cut or export-rule hit, a drug-pricing hit to GLP-1s, or a China demand slump or copper supply release.

handoff.what_changed: Crude fell five days (WTI 95.78, -5.5% over 5d) on improving Middle East flows, a possible Saudi pipeline fix and US-Iran diplomacy hopes. Chips rallied (SOXX +10% over 5d, AMD hit $1T); VIX 14.9. Copper rose six days toward a record on China tightness (Bloomberg); Lilly CEO said 700k new Medicare seniors started GLP-1s, 70% on Lilly drugs.

oil_gas.why: De-escalation headlines (flows improving, diplomacy hopes); no new named supply loss.

gold_miners.why: Fed hike and 10y near 5% are headwinds; no gold-specific catalyst.

chips.why: Held from Huang guidance call (to about 10-01); not renewed today as the rally priced much of it.

pharma.why: CNBC: 700k new Medicare seniors on GLP-1s, 70% on Lilly drugs; confidence 0.52.

copper_uranium.why: Bloomberg: copper up a sixth day toward record on China tightness; confidence 0.52.

open_storylines.name: Hormuz / Iran war, Saudi supply
open_storylines.note: Flows improving, Saudi pipeline fix possible, US-Iran diplomacy hopes; Iran says it will not surrender. Re-enter XOM only on a new named supply loss; a deal closes it.

open_storylines.name: XOM lagging crude
open_storylines.note: XOM -4.1% over 5d with WTI -5.5%; watch windfall tax, export curbs, Joliet refinery.

open_storylines.name: Yields, inflation and the Fed
open_storylines.note: 10y 4.96% after the hike; UN warns energy shock renews inflation risk. Jobs report within 20 days. Gold headwind.

open_storylines.name: AI demand, NVDA
open_storylines.note: Huang: twice as many chips next year; AMD $1T; Gelsinger-backed networking challenger. Exit NVDA on guidance cut or export-rule hit; hold ends about 10-01.

open_storylines.name: Tariffs and trade war
open_storylines.note: India tariffs over Russian oil; tariffs a midterm issue. Watch copper, Cameco, pharma tariffs.

open_storylines.name: Lilly GLP-1 uptake
open_storylines.note: Medicare coverage drove 700k new seniors, 70% Lilly. Watch pricing policy, compounding, trial news.

open_storylines.name: Copper tightness
open_storylines.note: Six-day rise toward record on China tightness; Congo ban status unknown. Exit on supply release or China demand slump.

open_storylines.name: Uranium supply
open_storylines.note: More supply (Niger investment, US output tripled); Cameco selling agent for GLE output. No CCJ catalyst.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day: check LLY (pricing or GLP-1 headlines) and FCX (copper record, China tightness, any supply release) held to about 10-06; check NVDA held to about 10-01 for guidance or export news; XOM flat unless a new named supply loss; watch yields, gold and the jobs report.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs on a named supply-shock escalation win over 10 days; later entries in a long-running episode do worse.
Hypothesis only: LLY longs after a trial or guidance catalyst have a positive mean net return over 10 days.
Hypothesis only: copper longs on a fresh supply-squeeze headline win.
lessons.evidence: FCX 07-31 +5.91% (CNBC squeeze), 08-10 +10.09% (Reuters Congo ban). Continuations: 08-05 -0.68%, 08-13 +17.10%, 08-18 +9.02%. No new closed trades.
